platform: Windows x86_64; official Godot 4.8.beta2.official.cafc17a19; headless GDScript reference
scope: Bounded software review and admission checks for the existing qualified Stik/Club fixed-wing companion profile. The separate solver receipt compares nine retained tapes with identical candidate CSV bytes; it is not exact replay or physical validation.

review.analysis: AppRoot adds separate airship/multirotor routes, Creator/airship Workshop trial handling and flag presentation. Main adds verified Creator-only startup, backend and visual branches. Ordinary fixed-wing launch still receives the checked companion configuration; Main rejects companions for Workshop and other technical routes. The focused checks below exercise admission and rejection; this is not semantic closure of all dependencies.

snapshot.description: Tracked app and sibling assets were copied from the live working tree before candidate identity renewal. After the checks and production flight, all other copied tracked bytes matched the live tree and original inventory; the two promoted JSON files matched candidate and live byte for byte. The tracked path set also matched. No file lock prevents concurrent edits between checks.
snapshot.inventory_format: JSON path to raw SHA-256 map; sorted keys, indent 2, LF with final LF; one inventory per tree
